strings: m_c has never had any trouble getting around, but one day {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/ask/asks} a strange question about how someone knew someone else was napping on the other side of camp, and r_c0 realizes {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} blind.

m_c fits in perfectly at first, but as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/grow/grows} and {VERB/m_c/open/opens} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes, it becomes clear that to m_c, there's no difference between having {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes closed or open.
